text:
Alice (oncall): Hey team — quick heads up during handoff: I'm primary for the 03:00 -> 11:00 shift but Ben (incoming primary) just pinged that he can't see prod Grafana dashboards or assume the prod AWS role. Need a quick plan so we don't have a coverage gap.

Oncall Bot: page sent to SRE-primary and SRE-secondary for any active incidents; if this is a handoff issue reply in-thread.

Alice (oncall): There's currently 1 active pager (INC-4522) for high error rate on /api/generate. I can cover for that incident for the first 15 mins but after that I need someone with Grafana and AWS-prod access to own follow-ups.

Ben SRE: Confirm — my SSO role doesn't include the cross-account role. I also don't have the Grafana org role. Just got onboarded last week and didn't get the prod perms. Sorry for the timing.

DevSecOps: OK, we can either grant Ben a temporary assume-role or swap primary to someone who already has access. Which would you prefer? If temporary role, Ben will need MFA and us to approve a short-lived role token (15min or 1h).

Carol Eng: I have full access to Grafana and the prod AWS role. If Alice wants to drop to secondary, I can take primary for the next window and own INC-4522. I'm available now.

Alice (oncall): Carol — thanks. That would be ideal. Ben stay on as second for context. Steps I'm doing now: 1) update PagerDuty to set Carol as primary, Ben as secondary 2) annotate incident with handoff note and assign Carol 3) transfer any open runbook pointers.

Ben SRE: Thanks — I'll stick on context. Can DevSecOps also note the missing perms so we can fix onboarding for future handoffs?

DevSecOps: Filed a perm ticket: DOCS-783. Also to grant temporary role, here's the standard assume-role command — Ben, only use if we opt for temp perms and after you confirm MFA.

Code block:

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall-Prod --role-session-name ben-handoff --duration-seconds 3600
# then export the creds returned as AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
```

DevSecOps: For Grafana, generate a one-time API key via the internal portal or have an admin add you to the 'prod-viewers' team. Quick smoke check for Grafana API access:

Code block:

```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <GRAFANA_API_KEY>' https://grafana.redwood.internal/api/search
```

Alice (oncall): PagerDuty update went through: Carol is now primary for the incident; Ben is secondary. I added a note: 'handoff: alice->carol due to access gap; ben remains secondary for context'.

Incidents Bot: INC-4522 annotated: handoff change recorded by Alice (oncall). Current owner: Carol Eng.

Carol Eng: Got it — taking ownership. First steps: check recent error spikes (grafana panels APM -> errors), tail prod logs for 10 minutes, and check the model-serving host pool metrics (hostpool/gpu-serve). If anyone has direct host links drop them here.

Alice (oncall): Host links in runbook. Quick link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff-checklist and the specific incident runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incidents/api-high-error-rate

Ben SRE: Logged note about perms in DOCS-783 and sent my onboarding owner a DM. Sorry again for the timing.

DevSecOps: Follow-up action items: 1) Grant Ben permanent prod-viewer Grafana role 2) Ensure SSO mapping includes Redwood-Oncall-Prod for new hires 3) Add handoff checklist verification to onboarding flow. I'll cc secops and infra.

Alice (oncall): Thanks everyone. Carol — if you run into anything that needs escalations, page SRE-lead (tag @sre-lead) and post a short status update in this thread. I'll be available for up to 30 more minutes before I fully hand off.

Carol Eng: Will do. Handoff complete from my side — primary ownership accepted. I'll post status after first 10m triage.

Alice (oncall): Confirming; handoff complete. Closing this handoff thread; leaving incident thread open.

Carol Eng: 10m triage: error rate trending down after rolling restart on model-serving node 7; watching. Will escalate if it reverses. :white_check_mark:
